originStory.title: Why I Wrote This Book
originStory.subtitle: **30+ years** of lessons I wish someone had shared with me
originStory.story:
Software development has been my passion since I was **10 years old**. Throughout my career, I've seen countless talented people struggle. Not because they lacked intelligence or coding ability, but because nobody taught them how professionals actually think.

I believe first principles are at the core of building a solid practice. I consider myself a software craftsperson, and I want apprentices. I want to help people grow. I want to see the 'Aha' moment when concepts finally click.

This book is my way of sharing everything I wish someone had told me when I started.
originStory.inspirationPoint: I want to see the 'Aha' moment when concepts finally click
